scene: The tunnel opens to Transit Plaza where three routes wait.
picture: A flat side view along a wide stone platform. Far left, a brass steam train puffs white vapour on low tracks. Centre, the player in her purple wheelchair pauses by a ticket booth. Up high, a blue airship swings from mooring ropes. Far right, a yellow delivery truck sits parked with its door open.
shown: a brass steam train idling on tracks with open doors at far left
a tethered blue airship gondola swinging gently up high
a yellow delivery truck parked with its cabin door ajar at far right
